scope: External source links in public research Markdown and CREDITS, excluding the generated archive guide itself, portfolio selflinks, loopback examples and private chat routes.

status_meanings.original_http_200: Original link responded successfully to a bounded anonymous check; reachability can change.
status_meanings.original_http_403: Request was denied; no access control was bypassed.
status_meanings.original_http_404: Anonymous endpoint returned not found; this does not distinguish removal from restricted account visibility.
status_meanings.snapshot_confirmed: Archive availability API listed a successful snapshot and its replay returned HTTP 200 with the expected page title.
status_meanings.snapshot_listed_replay_unavailable: The archive listed a snapshot but this run did not confirm successful replay; archived_url is null.
status_meanings.no_snapshot_returned: The archive availability response supplied no matching snapshot; this is not proof no snapshot exists anywhere.
status_meanings.lookup_unavailable: An archive lookup did not succeed, including service rate limiting.
status_meanings.not_queried_code_host_or_asset: No Wayback query for this code host/media asset. Use observed commit pins, separately licensed local snapshots or original offline analysis where supplied.

preservation_note: The package includes original analysis and a focused licensed source snapshot bundle. This index does not contain full forum pages, game archives, artwork, videos, model weights or private transcripts. Source hosts retain their rights; an archive link does not grant redistribution permission.
